findings.finding: Interrupted installation or rollback conflict resumes supervisor with a partial release.
findings.evidence: interrupt_second leaves first installed/second original; rollback_conflict resumes with first other/second original; both invoke restart.
findings.proposal: Durable intent and explicit release state; handle cancellation before resuming; complete verified rollback, otherwise keep admissions stopped with actionable recovery receipt. Do not unconditionally resume partial/conflicted runtime.

findings.finding: Safety and approval checks use assert and disappear under Python optimization.
findings.evidence: Optimized AST accepted REJECTED review and installed both fixture files, without executing task preflight.
findings.proposal: Use explicit if/raise; at minimum reject sys.flags.optimize before any mutating path and document invocation.

findings.finding: Existing evidence filenames are not preflighted before stopping web.
findings.evidence: Existing MAINTENANCE.json causes FileExistsError only after web_stopped; supervisor then resumes and restart runs.
findings.proposal: Check all receipt destinations before maintenance or use immutable attempt directories and a resumable intent; protect receipts with temp/verify/atomic publication.

findings.finding: Restart health failure leaves installed files and only restart_pending, without a durable failure/recovery receipt.
findings.evidence: restart_failure leaves both new files and DEPLOYMENT/MAINTENANCE, no RESTART or recovery record.
findings.proposal: Record restart failure with installed pins/process state and defined recovery path; never report successful availability from INSTALLED alone.

positives: Current prepare checks deadlines before/after hashes
Current source list pins maintenance.py and transaction.py
Reviewed plan/installer hashes checked before maintenance in normal interpreter
Normal fixture write failure restores original bytes
Protected temp/backup ACL-before-write design and server preamble not persisted in staging
limits: AST installer functions with injected maintenance, storage ACL and process boundaries
No actual plan generation, production import, service stop, runtime write, key read, HTTP or API call
R2 integrity confirmation does not replace Socrates final semantic review
